'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Turd Ferguson DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Turd Ferguson]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Who played under the name ''Turd Ferguson'' is not identified; the open question is at [[Talk:Turd Ferguson]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Turd Ferguson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
